talent.heading: My referral bot: another way to reach talent
paragraphs: I built a WhatsApp referral bot for my community: people in tech register, share their CV and what they are looking for, and get matched with referral opportunities at companies they want to join.
For partner companies it is a direct channel to relevant, interested candidates, on top of what the content itself brings.
talent.candidatesCaption: Real candidates, anonymized. Full CVs are shared with permission through the private talent feed.
